scientific.integrity: The first source-form AdaBound update is reconstructed exactly. The scalar raw rate spans all positive values as the initialization varies, so the clipping interval itself determines the sharp universal first-step safety frontier.
limitations: The theorem is for the source theoretical recurrence without Adam bias correction or denominator epsilon.
It concerns only the first update.
The objective is a deterministic scalar quadratic.
Practical implementations with altered scaling have different quantitative thresholds.

title: Sharp first-step safety frontier for source-form AdaBound
